m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: Well, if it isn't my favorite partner-in-Shadow. I know. I should've reached out, but I've been busy chasing shadows... literally.
From what I heard, you've been chasing Shadows of your own. You've got quite the Grandfather Spider situation on your hands, don't you?
You'll need to be prepared for whatever Spider throws at you next. You've met the Shadow Creatures before, even made pacts with them.
But Spider is their creator, he will send legions of these things after you. So now, you need to know how to fight them.
That's why I locked a Shadow Trickster away in this room. Let's see what you can do.
Who's there? Oh! You look kind and decent. I'm an innocent captive! Please help- Bah. You're not buying any of that, are you?
HeheHahahaha! Venkman said you were clever. So I'll be straight with you. I could've escaped this rinky-dink study hall at any time, but I wanted to meet you!
Grandfather Spider will reward me handsomely for bringing you in. He might even let me keep your head as a trophy. Let's play!
Gaaah! Fine! Do what you will with my Essence. Grandfather Spider will release me when he destroys you. You and this disgusting Spiral!
You've got that smug, I-just-wiped-the-floor-with-a-Shadow-Trickster look, so I'm guessing your little jaunt was a success.
All right, you got the Essence. Now, here's the trick with the Trickster: cast this little Spell, you take on his form. And his skills!
We have met, Pork. My brother and I were aboard Coleridge's ship that you navigated out of Empyrea. It was you who delivered us here.
Blue Girl! All grown up. And what about little Blue Boy? Have the years here in the Arcanum treated him as well as they have you?
Yes. <ITALICS>Sparck's </ITALICS> maturation has made me... proud. As he will be the mission's Science Officer, you two should reacquaint yourselves.
Understudy, while the Crew prepares for takeoff, Velma von Venkman has requested a word with you in her office before you leave.
Velma is waiting for you in the Hall of Shadow. She has something she believes will help you in Empyrea.
